entries.rationale: The independently validated Horgen normal lane follows positive stored path order. The catalog contains exactly two opposing main-carriageway lane1 detectors. The Zürich centre passes distance, projection and local bearing (-0.79); only the settlement extent fails. Its opposing lane follows negative stored path order. Alert-C signs are not used as path directions.

geometryReview.note: Official Seestrasse axis and intervening junctions reviewed; no measured turn flows.
